name: CVD-CNN-Benchmark
description: An evaluation suite comparing pre-trained convolutional neural network models on cardiovascular disease classification tasks from medical images.
reputation: A niche medical-imaging benchmark used in cardiovascular imaging research; modest adoption outside domain specialists.
notes: Medical imaging benchmark (non-LLM); potential privacy and dataset-bias concerns; performance depends strongly on imaging modality and label quality; dataset size/coverage may be limited.
